# Hot-path functions for ≥80% per-function coverage gate.
#
# Set per cucadmuh's request 2026-05-10: aggregate-crate gates (A/B/C/D)
# don't catch ungated Tauri-command wrappers in user-triggered sequences.
# Per-function ≥80% on the lists below ensures the actual hot path stays
# covered. Updated when extractions add or rename pure helpers.
#
# Each line is a substring match against rustc-mangled function names —
# the hash suffixes on monomorphic instantiations don't matter. Comments
# starting with `#` and blank lines are ignored.
